digest.component_or_area: file-impact data model and tri-state scope
propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded: both 'author forgot' and 'no repo file touched' map to the same value, requiring consumers to assume conservative reading; the story adds an explicit 'none' state to disambiguate.
FILE_IMPACT event payload and reducer state gain optional keys file_impact_scope (enum: undeclared, paths, none) and no_file_impact_reason to express tri-state mutual exclusivity.

set-file-impact CLI command moves from fixed-arity _REGISTRY to variadic _ARGV_REGISTRY to support two argument forms: JSON array (paths) or --none flag with reason, exactly one required, reason must have ≥10 non-whitespace characters.

New library function get_file_impact_scope(ticket_id) returns {kind, reason, paths} dict; new MCP tool declare_no_file_impact(ticket_id, reason) writes the same state as CLI with identical validation.
Reducer derivation helper computes file_impact_scope: non-empty file_impact → 'paths', empty file_impact + payload file_impact_scope=='none' → 'none', otherwise → 'undeclared'.

Existing get-file-impact output and behavior remain byte-for-byte unchanged; rebar show surfaces the two new state keys; state transitions between tri-states (paths ↔ none ↔ undeclared) are mutually exclusive last-writer-wins replacements.
